headline: Nvidia invests $1B in Naver in a quiet day
body: A quiet day. Nvidia said it will invest $1 billion in South Korea's Naver and widen a deal with SK Group for over 2 GW of AI data centers. More compute nudges Capability Velocity up, giving small lifts to Zookeeper and Enslaved God and a small dip to Reversion. Horizon Balance was nearly flat at -0.39.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Benevolent Dictator -0.02, from fading earlier news (-0.02).
